# pvecli sdn zones

List SDN zones and where they are actually deployed.

```text
pvecli sdn zones [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
